title: PTCalc: open computational tools for pharmaceutical technology
description:
Open-source web application (Blazor Server, .NET 10) and library for pharmaceutical technology computations. Modules: (1) dissolution-kinetics engine with 16 release models fitted by nonlinear least squares in the F(%) domain, AIC/AICc/MSC ranking and Akaike weights, Korsmeyer–Peppas F≤60% rule, Hopfenberg geometry exponents including the Karasulu half-sphere and triangle, results compared with DDSolver 1.0 outputs; (2) pseudo-ternary phase-diagram tool with polygon area and centroid calculation, in use since 2001; (3) f1/f2 similarity factors and model-independent profile metrics; (4) dose–response (LD50) and t-test utilities. Detailed bilingual guides with Crossref-verified references accompany the tools. Sites: https://ptcalc.net (English), https://ptcalc.tr (Turkish).

Türkçe: Farmasötik teknoloji için açık kaynak hesaplama araçları: dissolüsyon kinetiği motoru, psödo-üçlü faz diyagramı, f1/f2 benzerlik faktörleri, doz–yanıt ve t-testi.
